questions.cardText:
[Zoology] What effect do thyroid hormones have on tadpoles?
A. They cause tadpoles to change color
B. They regulate tadpoles’ metabolism
C. They induce metamorphosis from tadpoles to adult frogs
Answer: C. Thyroid hormones trigger the transformation of tadpoles into adult frogs, including limb development and tail absorption. Without these hormones, a tadpole would continue to grow larger and larger without metamorphosing.
questions.de: Welchen Vorgang, der Kaulquappen in erwachsene Frösche verwandelt, lösen Schilddrüsenhormone aus?
questions.en: Which process, turning tadpoles into adult frogs, do thyroid hormones trigger?

timeline.labelEn: Edward Calvin Kendall isolates the thyroid hormone thyroxine
timeline.labelDe: Edward Calvin Kendall isoliert das Schilddrüsenhormon Thyroxin

questions.notes: Wikipedia: thyroxine stimulates the apoptosis of larval gill, tail and fin cells in amphibian metamorphosis, transforming the tadpole into a frog. Card's option B is also partly true (thyroid hormones regulate metabolism generally).

questions.cardText:
[Linguistics] What is the meaning of the name Vladimir?
A. Gift of God
B. Brave warrior
C. Ruler of peace
Answer: C. The name Vladimir is derived from the Old Slavic elements “volod,” meaning “rule” or “power,” and “mir,” meaning “peace” or “world.”
questions.de: Was bedeutet der slawische Name Wladimir ursprünglich, gebildet aus vladĭ „herrschen“ und *mēri?
questions.en: What does the Slavic name Vladimir originally mean, from vladĭ “to rule” and *mēri?

timeline.labelEn: Death of Vladimir-Rasate, Bulgarian ruler and an early recorded bearer of the name Vladimir
timeline.labelDe: Tod von Wladimir Rasate, bulgarischer Herrscher und früh belegter Träger des Namens Wladimir

questions.notes: CARD ERROR: 'ruler of peace/world' is a folk etymology. Per Max Vasmer (Wikipedia), the second element is *mēri 'great, famous' (cf. Gothic -mērs), later associated with mir 'peace'/'world'; Wikipedia gives the meaning 'of great power'.
